meta.authorization: owner-stated; see Player_Animation_Project/ASSET_AUTHORIZATION.md; granting party and terms not on file
meta.cases_stepping: --fixed-fps 120: one process frame per physics tick, faster than real time

ideal.clip_speed_source: FootSlip.clip_travel (GA/vmm/bl/an.py method A at 15 Hz, as the plan's section 2 speeds)
ideal.gate_note: threshold_new_tree_mps (0.15, plan section 10) is below ideal_mps for several cases (run W/A/D/S at bow and pistol speed, sprint W, crouch D, the run and sprint diagonals), so perfect playback cannot pass it there. A reviewed gate relative to ideal_mps is an open orchestrator decision; see tests/anim/README.md.
ideal.method: what FootSlip.result() reads for perfect, graph-faithful playback: the case's section 6.5 direction bank (graph roles of the weapon; hemisphere fw iff |deg| <= 90) blended by the graph slerp chain, every clip at one normalized phase advancing at the section 6.6 rate (ratio = speed / sum w_i v_i clamped to [0.55, 1.75]), body at the case's target speed (player.gd speeds x weapon.speed_mult(), sprint without it) along the case direction; 8 start phases of the 2.0 s window, ideal_mps = their median. ideal_godot_mps: the same with the bank blended the Godot BlendSpace1D way (rest-relative). lib/selftest/st_footslip_ideal checks that the in-game measurement of a perfect one-clip tree lands in [ideal_min, ideal_max] +- 0.02.

meta.keys: <weapon>/<mode>/<dir>: mode walk (hold walk) / run / crouch (toggle) / sprint (hold sprint); dir W A S D WA WD. <weapon>/control/idle = standing still (after the pre-rolls for repeats 1-4), a check of the method (expected ~0).
meta.level: res://scenes/main.tscn, reloaded for every repeat; flat range lane, travel toward -Z; corridor checked free of colliders
meta.method: FootSlip (tests/anim/lib/foot_slip.gd): l/r heel and ball sampled at every pose update in Skeleton3D.skeleton_updated; foot world velocity = body velocity + d(foot offset from the body, world axes)/process delta (continuous-time slip); planted = world height within 0.02 m of the point's minimum over the window, at both ends of the interval; stats over all four points.
meta.protocol: FootSlip.measure v2: fresh level per repeat; repeat 0 fresh, repeats 1-4 after prerolls(c)
meta.realtime_stepping: no --fixed-fps: real-time main loop (only in the 'realtime' section; fresh repeat only by default)
meta.repeat_protocol: each repeat: reload level, wait 60 physics frames, switch_weapon, wait 150; repeat 0 runs the case directly (fresh_mps); repeat k>0 first runs FootSlip.prerolls(case)[k-1] (same mode 45 deg to one side 0.7 s, to the other side 1.3 s, the case itself 1.1 s then a stop, the next mode 0.9 s). median_mps = median of the repeat medians (plan section 10 metric); min_mps / max_mps / spread_mps = range over repeats.
meta.tree: old hand-built PlayerAnim AnimationTree (scripts/player/player_anim.gd before WP6)
meta.weapons_note: Only the lower body matters here. Bow and pistol move at speed_mult 1.0, the musket at 0.92, so bow and pistol should agree and the musket differs only through its speed.
